Hannah (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've published a small-but-important handbook change to the Time Off & Comp policy (section 4.2). It clarifies comp time accrual and manager approval steps. Please read and ack by end of next week.
Luis (Payroll): Note for payroll folks: comp approvals received before the 20th will reflect on that month's payroll; approvals after will roll to next month. We'll publish a cutoff calendar.
Mei (Eng): Does this affect how comp is reported for contractors who convert to full-time within the same month?
Hannah (People Ops): Good Q. Contractors who convert are handled case-by-case; recruiting should flag conversions so payroll can prorate comp. Samir, can recruiting include a conversion flag in the new hire packet?
Samir (Recruiting): Yep — adding a "conversion" checkbox to the onboarding checklist and will notify payroll via the HR intake form.
compliance-bot: Reminder: handbook ack required. Non-acknowledgment will trigger manager nudges after 10 days.
Ava (People Ops Lead): We'll also run a short 15-min digest session Tuesday 09:00 PT to walk through examples of accruals and approvals. If you're in EMEA/APAC and need an alternate time, reply with preferred window.
Mei (Eng): Can managers delegate approval to an admin for repeat requests? Some teams use admins.
Hannah (People Ops): Delegation is allowed but must be recorded in the manager delegation form linked in the handbook. Use the delegation template and cc people-ops.
Luis (Payroll): Small process tip: include the HR intake ID in the approval email to speed processing.
Samir (Recruiting): I'll update the offer templates and onboarding checklist today.
Hannah (People Ops): Final: ack deadline 2026-07-10. We'll post the cutoff calendar and the session invite in #people-ops this afternoon. Thanks all.
